localised_description: There are whispers, that you can catch the attention of a powerful assistance if you fight the forces of chaos. A stranger is said to be willing to fight by your side if you can prove your willingness to fight and bleed...
localised_mission_completed_text: After accepting your coin the stranger Introduces himself as a fellow asur named Idrinth. Taking off his travel ropes you see the battle worn armor of a lore master, a matching greatsword and a metal bow near stoic eyes hinting at brutalities yet to be committed.

localised_description: There are whispers, that you can catch the attention of a powerful assistance if you fight the forces of chaos. A stranger is said to be willing to fight by your side if you can prove your willingness to fight and bleed...
localised_mission_completed_text: The stranger lowers his hood, revealing elven features. I am no friend of destruction, but our enemies forced my hand. Pocketing his coins he states, Returning to family after many years when they are in danger is right, no matter who that family is. Don't you agree?

localised_description: There are whispers, that you can catch the attention of a powerful assistance if you fight the forces of chaos. A stranger is said to be willing to fight by your side if you can prove your willingness to fight and bleed...
localised_mission_completed_text: I have fought and bled with warriors believing in Ulfic or Sigmar. We have the same foes, he states as he removes his travel robes, and I look forward to driving them back with you. Sharing my knowledge for the betterment of the world. His eyes look coldly at praying humans before returning their attention to the general and his guard.

localised_description: There are whispers, that you can catch the attention of a powerful assistance if you fight the forces of chaos. A stranger is said to be willing to fight by your side if you can prove your willingness to fight and bleed...
localised_mission_completed_text: I look forward to fighting alongside the hunters of the woods, cousin, states the asur in a friendly tone while packing his payment and travel cloak. I may not be as great of a shot as you are, but I won't slow you down. A slightly amused smile plays around his bloodless lips before disappearing. Let us have a hunt that will be told of in centuries still!

localised_description: There are whispers, that you can catch the attention of a powerful assistance if you fight the forces of chaos. A stranger is said to be willing to fight by your side if you can prove your willingness to fight and bleed...
localised_mission_completed_text: The stranger disrobes himself after having been payed and reveals an elven face and elven weaponry beneath his travel robes. My name is Idrinth, I have been fighting our foes for longer than most of you have lived. I would enjoy practicing with the force and teaching them. A slight smile plays around his bloodless lips before it disappears in an ageless face.
